comparison: Table 3: Repoformer-1B/3B self-selective RAG (SelectiveT/SelectiveG) vs Always Retrieving with the same Repoformer model (cleanest). Table 2 (Repoformer vs StarCoderBase) and Table 5 (training ablations) rejected as multi-change.
